# KEI Events

> Full-service event planning and management in Champaign County, IL. Owned by Aricka Dean.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Event planning, bounce houses, games, catering, and decor
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy/): SMS opt-out, data collection, and privacy practices

## Internal pages

- [Leave a Review](/review/): Star rating funnel - routes 4-5 stars to Google, 1-3 stars to private feedback form

## Service pages

- [Bounce House Rental](/services/bounce-house-rental/): Bounce house and inflatable rental in Champaign IL with delivery, setup, and safety inspection included

- Birthday event planning
- Corporate event planning
- Bounce house rental
- Giant games
- Catering and vendor coordination
- Decor, balloons, and setup
- Any event: weddings, baby showers, retirements, holiday parties, brand activations
